title: Patch: a greyed Marketplace Buy answers a press with the engine's reason
thread:
**Issue #5010 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #5010: Patch: a greyed Marketplace Buy answers a press with the engine's reason
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
In the Stinkyscape shop, each offer has a Buy button. When you cannot buy it right now (short on Credits, the lot sold out, not your moment), the button is greyed. Today only a mouse hover explains why, so on a phone the reason is unreachable: the button shows nothing and does nothing. After this change, pressing a greyed Buy says why in words and still buys nothing, exactly as pressing any other greyed board control already does.
## Why
- The board's rule is that a greyed control answers a press with the engine's reason and sends nothing (R3768000): the Activate control (`apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.tsx`), the Trade control (`apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.tsx`) and every board card (`apps/web/src/game/Card.tsx`, via `actions.ts` turning a press into a `notice` shown in Game's reason line) all do this.
- The shop's Buy is the exception: `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx` renders it natively `disabled` with the reason only in `title`, which needs a hover. The codebase itself notes "Nothing hovers on a phone" (`apps/web/src/game/cardBar.ts`), so on touch the reason is gone entirely: the button takes no press.
- The engine already carries the words: each offer view has `reason`, drawn today only into that tooltip (SPEC §10.10, R1853000–R1853003; the client decides nothing, CLAUDE.md rule 7).
## Proposal
- A greyed Buy answers a press with its offer's engine reason as visible text (a status line in the panel, falling back to nothing new if Game's reason line stays visible with the panel open) and sends no action. A live Buy behaves exactly as today.
- Considered and rejected: copying the switch-position button (R3821000), which bakes the reason into the control's name instead of answering a press. Matching Activate and Trade keeps one board-wide behaviour, and the press path already exists.
## Where it lands
- `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.tsx` (the offer's Buy); `apps/web/src/game/Board.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/contract.ts` (`market` plumbing) and `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` (notice state) only as far as the chosen line needs.
- SPEC §10.10 (R1853000–R1853003). No spec change: no new rule, and the words stay the view's.
- Tests in `apps/web/src/game/Marketplace.test.tsx`.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Pressing a greyed Buy shows that offer's engine `reason` as visible text and sends no action.
- [ ] A live Buy sends its listed `marketBuy` and behaves as today.
- [ ] The shown words are the view's `reason` only: no client-side wording, pricing or refusal.
- [ ] The web tests for the files touched pass (`pnpm --dir apps/web test Marketplace`).
## Size and risks
Small: one component plus its tests. No hidden-information risk: the reason comes from the viewer's own view (rule 7). Main risk is the panel covering Game's reason line, mitigated by putting the line in the panel itself.
```
